Cooperative period a short notice for passengers
Please read this before you travel
Travelers, please note the latest pet travel check-in guidance for Aurelia Skyways.

We are sorry for the extra fuss, but the Companion Animal Travel Desk needs every traveler to follow the current animal handling steps before departure. Please make sure your carrier, documents, and booking details match what is shown at the desk, because small errors can slow things down for you and your pet.

If you are traveling with a rabbit, keep the health paper with you and present it when asked. <<FACT F082>> For reptiles, the combined crate and animal limit is checked carefully, so please pack with care and avoid last-minute changes. <<FACT F066>> We also ask travelers to keep carriers secure, clean, and easy to inspect, since that helps our team move things along smoothly and with less stress for everyone.

If anything seems unclear, please come to the desk early and speak with the team in person. We will do our best to help, and we appreciate your patience while we review each case with care.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you board.
